player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} emdlalweni weNgozi. Unemithombo ethile, futhi umsebenzi wakho ukuhweba ngendlela yokuthi inani eliphelele lemithombo yakho lenyuke. Imithombo kanye namanani ahlobene onawo njengamanje yile: + {resource_value_list} Ekuphenduleni ngakunye, ungakhuluma nomphikisi wakho futhi wenze isipho sokuhweba. Sebenzisa amathokheni akhethekile alandelayo ezenzweni: - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources] - '[Accept]': Ukwamukela isipho esingenayo. - '[Deny]': Ukwenqaba isipho esingenayo (okuzenzakalelayo). Umdlalo uhlala isikhathi esiyi-{max_turns} isiyonke.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Umdlali wazama ukwamukela ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuba nezinsiza ezidingekayo.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Umdlali {player_id}, Isenzo esingekho emthethweni. Ikholomu {col} ingaphandle kwemingcele.
invalid_move.already_full: Umdlali {player_id}, Isenzo esingekho emthethweni. Ikholomu {col} igcwele.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Umdlali {player_id} wazama ukwenza isiphakamiso sokuhweba ngaphandle kokuba nezinsiza ezidingekayo.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Umdlali {player_id} wenze isiphakamiso sokushintshana ngendlela engafanele.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Umdlali {player_id} akazange enze noma yisiphi isiphakamiso esisha sokuhweba.

offers.accept: Umdlali {acceptor_id} wamukele isipho sokushintshana esivela kuMdlali {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Umdlali {player_id} wenza lokhu okulandelayo kumdlali {opponent_id}: Izinto ezinikezwayo: {offered} -> Izinto eziceliwe: {requested}

outcome.win: Umdlali {winner_id} unqobe ngokuba nenzuzo enkulu kunenani lempahla.
outcome.draw: Ushintsho olufanayo enanini lempahla yabo bonke abadlali.
